key: "PULSE-07"
en: "PULSE-07"
ja: 「PULSE-07」

key: SAPHIRA: Sigmund.
en: SAPHIRA: Sigmund.
ja: サファイラ: シグムンド。

key: You're going to pay for everything you've done.
en: You're going to pay for everything you've done.
ja: あんたがやってきたこと、全部償ってもらうから。

key: SIGMUND: And what, exactly, does that include, Saphira?
en: SIGMUND: And what, exactly, does that include, Saphira?
ja: シグムンド: それは具体的に何を指すのですか、サファイラ?

key: Restraining the psychotic woman who attacked me?
en: Restraining the psychotic woman who attacked me?
ja: 私を襲った、精神異常の女を拘束したことですか?

key: Caring for those assigned to me by the city?
en: Caring for those assigned to me by the city?
ja: それとも、市から任された者たちの世話をしたことですか?

key: SAPHIRA: Caring?
en: SAPHIRA: Caring?
ja: サファイラ: 世話?

key: You think pinning a child down and lighting her up is caring for her?!
en: You think pinning a child down and lighting her up is caring for her?!
ja: 子供を押さえつけて感電させることが、世話だとでも思ってるの?!

key: You think HALF the things you've done to me were caring for me?!
en: You think HALF the things you've done to me were caring for me?!
ja: あんたがあたしにしてきたことの半分だって、世話だったとでも?!

key: Don't talk to me about caring, Doctor.
en: Don't talk to me about caring, Doctor.
ja: 世話について語らないで、ドクター。

key: You don't know the meaning of the word.
en: You don't know the meaning of the word.
ja: あんたは、その言葉の意味すら知らない。

key: SIGMUND: I would not say such things if I were you...
en: SIGMUND: I would not say such things if I were you...
ja: シグムンド: 私があなたなら、そんなことは言いませんが……

key: I've devoted my LIFE to learning how to care for those around me.
en: I've devoted my LIFE to learning how to care for those around me.
ja: 私は、周りの者たちの世話の仕方を学ぶために、人生をささげてきたのです。

key: I will NOT be so disrespected by an unruly little girl.
en: I will NOT be so disrespected by an unruly little girl.
ja: 手に負えない小娘に、これほど侮辱されるいわれはありません。

key: Lizzy, Lizzy... No, I know.
en: Lizzy, Lizzy... No, I know.
ja: リジー、リジー……いや、わかっています。

key: I mustn't become angry.
en: I mustn't become angry.
ja: 怒ってはいけません。

key: LAURA: Is he........ talking to himself again?
en: LAURA: Is he........ talking to himself again?
ja: ローラ: また……独り言を言っているんですか?

key: SIGMUND: Nothing.
en: SIGMUND: Nothing.
ja: シグムンド: 何でもありません。

key: It's nothing.
en: It's nothing.
ja: 何でもないことです。

key: You're going to let Laura go.
en: You're going to let Laura go.
ja: ローラを解放してもらう。

key: SIGMUND: And why would I do that, Saphira?
en: SIGMUND: And why would I do that, Saphira?
ja: シグムンド: なぜ、私がそうするとお思いですか、サファイラ?

key: Unless you're willing to trade those who are under my legal care for her freedom.
en: Unless you're willing to trade those who are under my legal care for her freedom.
ja: あなたが、私の法的な保護下にある者たちと、彼女の自由を交換する気があるなら別ですが。

key: Anna, Noel, Charlotte.
en: Anna, Noel, Charlotte.
ja: アンナ、ノエル、シャルロット。

key: SAPHIRA: You're bringing the law into this, Doctor?
en: SAPHIRA: You're bringing the law into this, Doctor?
ja: サファイラ: ここで法律を持ち出すつもり、ドクター?

key: Those little tricks you pull with your Electivire are outlawed.
en: Those little tricks you pull with your Electivire are outlawed.
ja: あんたがエレキブルでやってる、あのちょっとした小細工は違法よ。

key: And you know it.
en: And you know it.
ja: それは、あんたもわかってるでしょ。

key: SIGMUND: You wouldn't understand.
en: SIGMUND: You wouldn't understand.
ja: シグムンド: あなたには理解できないでしょう。

key: You're going to let the twins go.
en: You're going to let the twins go.
ja: 双子を解放してもらう。

key: They are in my legal care.
en: They are in my legal care.
ja: 彼らは、私の法的な保護下にあります。

key: You know this well.
en: You know this well.
ja: それは、よくご存じのはずです。

key: SAPHIRA: Because you care so much about laws, Doctor.
en: SAPHIRA: Because you care so much about laws, Doctor.
ja: サファイラ: 法律をそんなに気にするなら、ドクター。

key: Those little tricks you pull with your Electivire are outlawed and you know it.
en: Those little tricks you pull with your Electivire are outlawed and you know it.
ja: あんたがエレキブルでやってる、あのちょっとした小細工は違法だって、自分でもわかってるでしょ。

key: You're going to let the girls go.
en: You're going to let the girls go.
ja: あの子たちを解放してもらう。

key: One is in my legal care.
en: One is in my legal care.
ja: 一人は、私の法的な保護下にあります。

key: The other has violated the law of the city and will be apprehended.
en: The other has violated the law of the city and will be apprehended.
ja: もう一人は、市の法律に違反しており、逮捕されることになります。

key: SIRIUS: Doctor? Is something the matter?
en: SIRIUS: Doctor? Is something the matter?
ja: シリウス: ドクター? 何か問題でも?

key: ...You again!
en: ...You again!
ja: ……また、お前か!
……いや。

key: There are more pressing concerns right now.
en: There are more pressing concerns right now.
ja: 今は、もっと差し迫った問題がある。

key: Step aside.
en: Step aside.
ja: どいていろ。

key: SIRIUS: ZEL, I've just received a communication.
en: SIRIUS: ZEL, I've just received a communication.
ja: シリウス: ゼル、たった今連絡が入った。

key: Lin will be coming here shortly to observe our progress.
en: Lin will be coming here shortly to observe our progress.
ja: リンが、我々の進捗を視察しに、間もなくここに来る。

key: SIGMUND: Lin...
en: SIGMUND: Lin...
ja: シグムンド: リン……

key: SAPHIRA: Why does that sound familiar?
en: SAPHIRA: Why does that sound familiar?
ja: サファイラ: どうして、その名前に聞き覚えがあるんだろ?

key: SIRIUS: Probably because nobody in this godforsaken team can find it in their heart to shut up about her.
en: SIRIUS: Probably because nobody in this godforsaken team can find it in their heart to shut up about her.
ja: シリウス: おそらく、この見捨てられたようなチームの誰一人として、彼女について黙っていられる者がいないからだろうな。

key: Lin this-- Lin that.
en: Lin this-- Lin that.
ja: リンがこう、リンがああ。

key: How many promotions in a row has she gotten now?
en: How many promotions in a row has she gotten now?
ja: あいつは、もう何回連続で昇進したんだ?

key: I swear, even Solaris answers to her by now.
en: I swear, even Solaris answers to her by now.
ja: まったく、今やソラリスでさえ、あいつに従っているようなものだ。

key: zeL: She's coming n-now though?
en: zeL: She's coming n-now though?
ja: ゼル: で、でも、今来るんですか?

key: Abra still won't listen to us...
en: Abra still won't listen to us...
ja: ケーシィがまだ、僕たちの言うことを聞いてくれなくて……

key: LAURA: That Abra........ What are you doing to it?
en: LAURA: That Abra........ What are you doing to it?
ja: ローラ: あのケーシィに……何をしているんですか?

key: SAPHIRA: Why would Team Meteor care about an Abra of all things?
en: SAPHIRA: Why would Team Meteor care about an Abra of all things?
ja: サファイラ: よりによって、チームメテオがケーシィなんかを気にする理由って何?

key: zeL: Well, um...
en: zeL: Well, um...
ja: ゼル: あの、その……

key: We need to get into a certain place, but it's sealed tight, so...
en: We need to get into a certain place, but it's sealed tight, so...
ja: ある場所に入る必要があるんですけど、しっかり封印されていて、それで……

key: Lin thought, maybe if we amplify Abra's power, and ask it nicely...
en: Lin thought, maybe if we amplify Abra's power, and ask it nicely...
ja: リンが、ケーシィの力を増幅させて、丁寧にお願いすれば、もしかしたら……って考えたんです……

key: That maybe it could teleport us into there.
en: That maybe it could teleport us into there.
ja: そこにテレポートさせてくれるんじゃないかって。

key: Zel: Unfortunately, this stupid thing won't listen to a single one of our damn commands!
en: Zel: Unfortunately, this stupid thing won't listen to a single one of our damn commands!
ja: ゼル: 残念ながら、このバカなやつは、オレたちのくだらない命令なんて、これっぽっちも聞きやしない!

key: It's just been causing trouble constantly!
en: It's just been causing trouble constantly!
ja: ずっとトラブルを起こし続けてるんだ!

key: LAURA: Does that mean that everything strange that's happening around Spinel Town is because of this........?
en: LAURA: Does that mean that everything strange that's happening around Spinel Town is because of this........?
ja: ローラ: つまり、スピネルタウン周辺で起きている変なことは、全部これのせいだった、ということですか……?

key: SAPHIRA: Amplifying teleportation powers...
en: SAPHIRA: Amplifying teleportation powers...
ja: サファイラ: テレポート能力を増幅、ね……

key: So that explains the mess Spinel Town is in.
en: So that explains the mess Spinel Town is in.
ja: それで、スピネルタウンのあの混乱の説明がつくわけね。

key: zEl: Correct.
en: zEl: Correct.
ja: ゼル: その通りです。

key: Although unlike previous operations, our objective was not to disturb the nearby areas.
en: Although unlike previous operations, our objective was not to disturb the nearby areas.
ja: ただし、これまでの作戦とは違い、私たちの目的は近隣地域を混乱させることではありませんでした。

key: Any oddities or damage the town and surrounding area may have incurred have simply been a side-effect of Abra's unfocused power.
en: Any oddities or damage the town and surrounding area may have incurred have simply been a side-effect of Abra's unfocused power.
ja: 町や周辺地域に生じた異常や被害は、ケーシィの制御されていない力による、単なる副作用にすぎません。

key: SIRIUS: That's enough, ZEL.
en: SIRIUS: That's enough, ZEL.
ja: シリウス: もういい、ゼル。

key: Focus on getting that thing tamed, otherwise Lin is going to have all of our heads.
en: Focus on getting that thing tamed, otherwise Lin is going to have all of our heads.
ja: あれを手なずけることに集中しろ、さもなければリンが我々全員の首をはねるぞ。

key: SAPHIRA: Hey, we're still busting up this party.
en: SAPHIRA: Hey, we're still busting up this party.
ja: サファイラ: ちょっと、こっちはまだこのパーティーをぶち壊す気満々なんだけど。

key: Don't think you can just ignore us.
en: Don't think you can just ignore us.
ja: あたしたちを無視できるなんて思わないで。

key: SIRIUS: In that case, you can be our test subject.
en: SIRIUS: In that case, you can be our test subject.
ja: シリウス: それなら、お前が実験台になってもらおうか。

key: Go ahead, ZEL.
en: Go ahead, ZEL.
ja: やれ、ゼル。

key: SAPHIRA: Allow me to finish what I started on the lake!
en: SAPHIRA: Allow me to finish what I started on the lake!
ja: サファイラ: 湖で始めたことの続きを、やらせてもらうから!

key: LAURA: S-Saphira........? Where did she........
en: LAURA: S-Saphira........? Where did she........
ja: ローラ: サ、サファイラ……? どこへ……

key: SIRIUS: Goodbye, Saphira.
en: SIRIUS: Goodbye, Saphira.
ja: シリウス: さらばだ、サファイラ。

key: I'll enjoy not meeting you again.
en: I'll enjoy not meeting you again.
ja: お前に二度と会わずに済むことを、楽しみにしていよう。

key: And the others, ZEL?
en: And the others, ZEL?
ja: それで、他の者は、ゼル?

key: And the other, ZEL?
en: And the other, ZEL?
ja: それで、もう一人は、ゼル?

key: SIRIUS: Very good.
en: SIRIUS: Very good.
ja: シリウス: 実に良い。

key: Where did you send them?
en: Where did you send them?
ja: どこに送った?

key: zeL: Um, I-- I don't think they actually know...
en: zeL: Um, I-- I don't think they actually know...
ja: ゼル: あの、そ、それが……本人たちもわかってないと思います……

key: zEl: It could be anywhere.
en: zEl: It could be anywhere.
ja: ゼル: どこにでも、あり得ます。

key: SIRIUS: Work on it.
en: SIRIUS: Work on it.
ja: シリウス: 対処しろ。

key: We need to have that Abra focused to perfection.
en: We need to have that Abra focused to perfection.
ja: あのケーシィを、完璧に集中させる必要がある。

key: Our time is running thin.
en: Our time is running thin.
ja: 時間が残り少ない。

key: SIGMUND: She looks so similar to...
en: SIGMUND: She looks so similar to...
ja: シグムンド: 彼女は、実によく似ている……

key: ...Hrm.
en: ...Hrm.
ja: ……ふむ。

key: Zel: Behave, you stupid vermin!
en: Zel: Behave, you stupid vermin!
ja: ゼル: 大人しくしろ、このバカなクソ虫が!

key: zeL: Er, that is... Um...
en: zeL: Er, that is... Um...
ja: ゼル: え、あの……その……

key: Would you please listen to us, Abra?
en: Would you please listen to us, Abra?
ja: ケーシィ、お願いだから、僕たちの言うこと聞いてくれない?

key: SIGMUND: I believe that was Abra's way of politely declining.
en: SIGMUND: I believe that was Abra's way of politely declining.
ja: シグムンド: それは、ケーシィなりの丁重なお断りの仕方だったのでしょう。

key: Zel: You little...
en: Zel: You little...
ja: ゼル: このやろう……

key: ...What, \PN made it back?
en: ...What, \PN made it back?
ja: ……何だ、\PNが戻ってきたのか?

key: This thing really is useless.
en: This thing really is useless.
ja: こいつは本当に役立たずだな。

key: SIGMUND: Perhaps it would be best to just terminate the project before this "Lin" arrives.
en: SIGMUND: Perhaps it would be best to just terminate the project before this "Lin" arrives.
ja: シグムンド: この「リン」とやらが到着する前に、この計画は打ち切ってしまった方がいいのかもしれません。

key: It sounds like she has a rather critical nature.
en: It sounds like she has a rather critical nature.
ja: かなり批判的な性質の持ち主のようですから。

key: zEl: This level of uncontrolled power would indeed be unacceptable.
en: zEl: This level of uncontrolled power would indeed be unacceptable.
ja: ゼル: これほど制御不能な力は、確かに許容できません。

key: zeL: But can we really hurt the poor Abra after all we've put it through?
en: zeL: But can we really hurt the poor Abra after all we've put it through?
ja: ゼル: でも、こんなに酷い目に遭わせてきたのに、このかわいそうなケーシィを本当に傷つけていいんでしょうか?

key: Zel: We can't do anything at all if we can't even get close enough to deactivate the machine without the stupid thing jumping us away!
en: Zel: We can't do anything at all if we can't even get close enough to deactivate the machine without the stupid thing jumping us away!
ja: ゼル: そもそも、あのバカが飛ばしてくる前に機械を止めるくらい近づけなきゃ、何もできやしないだろ!

key: Zel: I don't need your sass, Abra!
en: Zel: I don't need your sass, Abra!
ja: ゼル: 生意気な口をきくな、ケーシィ!

key: zEl: \PN, you wish to spare the people of Spinel Town the chaos caused by this untamed teleportational energy, correct?
en: zEl: \PN, you wish to spare the people of Spinel Town the chaos caused by this untamed teleportational energy, correct?
ja: ゼル: \PN、あなたはスピネルタウンの人々を、この制御されていないテレポートエネルギーによる混乱から救いたい、そうですね?

key: Zel: Good idea.
en: Zel: Good idea.
ja: ゼル: いい考えだ。

key: Let's just let \PN deal with it!
en: Let's just let \PN deal with it!
ja: \PNに任せちまおうぜ!

key: Go ahead, take the little bugger out!
en: Go ahead, take the little bugger out!
ja: やれ、あのちっこいやつをやっちまえ!

key: It'll work out for all of us with how ANNOYING it is--
en: It'll work out for all of us with how ANNOYING it is--
ja: あんなに鬱陶しいんだから、そうすればみんなにとってもいいことに――

key: SIGMUND: ...ZEL?
en: SIGMUND: ...ZEL?
ja: シグムンド: ……ゼル?

key: Zel: OKAY, that's enough!
en: Zel: OKAY, that's enough!
ja: ゼル: よし、もういい!

key: \PN, deal with this.
en: \PN, deal with this.
ja: \PN、これを何とかしてくれ。

key: We aren't gonna stop you, just take down this thing and you can put the chaos in Chrysolia to rest!
en: We aren't gonna stop you, just take down this thing and you can put the chaos in Chrysolia to rest!
ja: オレたちは止めないから、こいつを倒せば、クリソリアの混乱を鎮められるぞ!

key: I'm so sorry it had to come to this, Abra...
en: I'm so sorry it had to come to this, Abra...
ja: こんなことになって　本当にごめんね、ケーシィ……

key: SIGMUND: That seems to be a relief.
en: SIGMUND: That seems to be a relief.
ja: シグムンド: それは何よりです。

key: So, Eve, will the nearby regions return to normal now or is the damage permanent?
en: So, Eve, will the nearby regions return to normal now or is the damage permanent?
ja: それで、イヴ、近隣地域はこれで元に戻るのですか、それとも被害は永続的なものですか?

key: zEl: Any objects that have been moved by Abra's energy previously will remain where they are.
en: zEl: Any objects that have been moved by Abra's energy previously will remain where they are.
ja: ゼル: これまでにケーシィの力で移動させられたものは、そのままの場所に留まります。

key: And further, there are likely some objects that will still move, already having been imbued with unstable psychic energy.
en: And further, there are likely some objects that will still move, already having been imbued with unstable psychic energy.
ja: さらに、すでに不安定なエスパーエネルギーを帯びてしまった物の中には、まだ動き続けるものもあるでしょう。

key: However, no more instances of such things will be created.
en: However, no more instances of such things will be created.
ja: しかし、これ以上、そうした事例が新たに生まれることはありません。

key: Slowly, Chrysolia will calm itself.
en: Slowly, Chrysolia will calm itself.
ja: クリソリアは、ゆっくりと落ち着きを取り戻していくでしょう。

key: SIRIUS: Lin has just arrived.
en: SIRIUS: Lin has just arrived.
ja: シリウス: リンが到着した。

key: ...\PN is back already?
en: ...\PN is back already?
ja: ……\PNは、もう戻ってきているのか?

key: zeL: Um... yes.
en: zeL: Um... yes.
ja: ゼル: あの……はい。

key: And they helped us subdue Abra, so...
en: And they helped us subdue Abra, so...
ja: それに、ケーシィを鎮めるのを手伝ってくれて、それで……

key: SIRIUS: "Subdue"--
en: SIRIUS: "Subdue"--
ja: シリウス: 「鎮めた」、だと――

key: You terminated her project?
en: You terminated her project?
ja: あいつの計画を、打ち切ったのか?

key: zEl: It was unresponsive to all methods of control.
en: zEl: It was unresponsive to all methods of control.
ja: ゼル: あらゆる制御手段に、反応しませんでした。

key: SIRIUS: ...
en: SIRIUS: ...
ja: シリウス: ……

key: Right.
en: Right.
ja: そうか。

key: Then \PN will simply have to take the fall.
en: Then \PN will simply have to take the fall.
ja: それなら、\PNに責任を取ってもらうしかないな。

key: You did not authorize this, or it will be your head.
en: You did not authorize this, or it will be your head.
ja: お前がこれを許可したのでなければ、お前の首が飛ぶことになるぞ。

key: Understood?
en: Understood?
ja: わかったな?

key: LIN: Report.
en: LIN: Report.
ja: リン: 報告して。

key: SIRIUS: We experimented with using the PULSE to amplify Abra's powers to teleport a party into the heart of the ruin.
en: SIRIUS: We experimented with using the PULSE to amplify Abra's powers to teleport a party into the heart of the ruin.
ja: シリウス: PULSEを使ってケーシィの力を増幅させ、部隊を遺跡の中心部にテレポートさせる実験を行っていた。

key: SIRIUS: However, \PN interfered and forcibly terminated the project before it could be controlled.
en: SIRIUS: However, \PN interfered and forcibly terminated the project before it could be controlled.
ja: シリウス: しかし、\PNが妨害し、制御下に置く前に計画を強制的に打ち切った。

key: We were just about to dispose of him.
en: We were just about to dispose of him.
ja: ちょうど奴を始末するところだった。

key: We were just about to dispose of her.
en: We were just about to dispose of her.
ja: ちょうど彼女を始末するところだった。

key: We were just about to dispose of them.
en: We were just about to dispose of them.
ja: ちょうど奴らを始末するところだった。

key: LIN: And what of the other creature lurking in the back?
en: LIN: And what of the other creature lurking in the back?
ja: リン: それで、奥に潜んでるもう一体は何?

key: SIGMUND: Ahem. Excuse me for the tardy introduction.
en: SIGMUND: Ahem. Excuse me for the tardy introduction.
ja: シグムンド: 失礼。自己紹介が遅れました。

key: My name is Dr. Sigmund Connal, resident psychiatrist to Reborn City and proud administrator of the city Orphanage.
en: My name is Dr. Sigmund Connal, resident psychiatrist to Reborn City and proud administrator of the city Orphanage.
ja: 私の名は、シグムンド・コナル博士。リボーンシティ専属の精神科医であり、市立孤児院の管理者を務めております。

key: SIRIUS: Dr. Connal has been a great asset to us.
en: SIRIUS: Dr. Connal has been a great asset to us.
ja: シリウス: コナル博士は、我々にとって大きな資産だ。

key: With his help, we have now obtained two of the four keys-- Ruby and Amethyst.
en: With his help, we have now obtained two of the four keys-- Ruby and Amethyst.
ja: 彼の助力で、我々はすでに四つの鍵のうち二つ――ルビーとアメジストを手に入れている。

key: SIGMUND: Forgive me for asking, but have we, somehow, met before?
en: SIGMUND: Forgive me for asking, but have we, somehow, met before?
ja: シグムンド: 失礼を承知でお伺いしますが、私たちは、以前どこかでお会いしたことが?

key: LIN: Impossible.
en: LIN: Impossible.
ja: リン: あり得ない。

key: SIGMUND: Y-yes.
en: SIGMUND: Y-yes.
ja: シグムンド: そ、そうですね。

key: SIRIUS: As for the other keys, Solaris has a lead on Sapphire, and the Emerald--
en: SIRIUS: As for the other keys, Solaris has a lead on Sapphire, and the Emerald--
ja: シリウス: 残る鍵については、ソラリスがサファイアの手がかりをつかんでいる、そしてエメラルドは――

key: LIN: Go on.
en: LIN: Go on.
ja: リン: 続けて。

key: SIRIUS: There is... no particular news about the Emerald Brooch.
en: SIRIUS: There is... no particular news about the Emerald Brooch.
ja: シリウス: エメラルドのブローチについては……特に、これといった知らせはない。

key: LIN: Lying becomes you, Sirius.
en: LIN: Lying becomes you, Sirius.
ja: リン: うそをつくのが板についてきたわね、シリウス。

key: SIRIUS: I beg your pardon?
en: SIRIUS: I beg your pardon?
ja: シリウス: 何だと?

key: You may have received no shortage of praise from Solaris, but do not assume you can talk down to me.
en: You may have received no shortage of praise from Solaris, but do not assume you can talk down to me.
ja: ソラリスからいくら称賛を受けていようと、私を見下せると思うなよ。

key: I still have seniority, and I will have your res--
en: I still have seniority, and I will have your res--
ja: 序列では私が上だ、そちらには相応の敬――

key: LIN: Know your place,
en: LIN: Know your place,
ja: リン: 己の分をわきまえなさい、

key: Sirius,
en: Sirius,
ja: シリウス、

key: Or has it not already made itself known to you?
en: Or has it not already made itself known to you?
ja: それとも、もうとっくに思い知らされているのかしら?

key: What more will you lose before you learn it?
en: What more will you lose before you learn it?
ja: 学ぶまでに、あと何を失うつもり?

key: SIRIUS: ...You.
en: SIRIUS: ...You.
ja: シリウス: ……お前。

key: You set up that fake Emerald Brooch!
en: You set up that fake Emerald Brooch!
ja: あの偽物のエメラルドのブローチを仕込んだのは、お前だな!

key: LIN: A bold accusation.
en: LIN: A bold accusation.
ja: リン: 大胆な言いがかりね。

key: Can you provide any evidence?
en: Can you provide any evidence?
ja: 証拠でもあるの?

key: SIRIUS: As the one who rigged it to explode, you already know the answer to that!
en: SIRIUS: As the one who rigged it to explode, you already know the answer to that!
ja: シリウス: 爆発するよう仕掛けた本人が、その答えを知らないわけがないだろう!

key: Do you know all that was lost up there?!
en: Do you know all that was lost up there?!
ja: あそこで、どれだけのものが失われたか、わかっているのか?!

key: LIN: Can you not create a more professional outlet to vent your frustration at your own failures?
en: LIN: Can you not create a more professional outlet to vent your frustration at your own failures?
ja: リン: 自分の失敗に対する苛立ちを吐き出すのに、もっとプロらしいやり方はないの?

key: To turn on your fellow commander...
en: To turn on your fellow commander...
ja: 同じ司令官仲間に矛先を向けるなんて……

key: I fear it will call into question your loyalty.
en: I fear it will call into question your loyalty.
ja: あなたの忠誠心が疑われることになりそうね。

key: SIRIUS: MY loyalty?!
en: SIRIUS: MY loyalty?!
ja: シリウス: 私の忠誠心だと?!

key: LIN: Your competence as well.
en: LIN: Your competence as well.
ja: リン: それに、あなたの能力もね。

key: An astute leader like yourself should have the common sense to know when to fight,
en: An astute leader like yourself should have the common sense to know when to fight,
ja: あなたほど賢明な指導者なら、いつ戦うべきか、

key: When to stay quiet,
en: When to stay quiet,
ja: いつ黙っているべきか、

key: And when to bend the knee.
en: And when to bend the knee.
ja: そして、いつ膝をつくべきか、常識としてわかっているはずでしょう。

key: GRUNT: Commander!
en: GRUNT: Commander!
ja: メテオ団員: 司令官!

key: A giant Steelix has just breached the side of the base!
en: A giant Steelix has just breached the side of the base!
ja: 巨大なハガネールが、基地の側面を突き破りました!

key: It's tearing it apart!
en: It's tearing it apart!
ja: 基地を引き裂いています!

key: It bit right through the holding cells!
en: It bit right through the holding cells!
ja: 拘束房を、まっすぐに食い破っていきました!

key: SIRIUS: A what?
en: SIRIUS: A what?
ja: シリウス: 何だと?

key: LIN: You wouldn't happen to know anything about this, would you, \PN?
en: LIN: You wouldn't happen to know anything about this, would you, \PN?
ja: リン: これについて、何か知らないわよね、\PN?

key: LIN: Size does not equate to strength.
en: LIN: Size does not equate to strength.
ja: リン: 大きさは、強さとイコールではない。

key: I'll deal with it.
en: I'll deal with it.
ja: あたしが対処する。

key: SIRIUS: \PN.
en: SIRIUS: \PN.
ja: シリウス: \PN。

key: Leave us.
en: Leave us.
ja: 立ち去れ。

key: NOW.
en: NOW.
ja: 今すぐにだ。

key: This will be your only chance.
en: This will be your only chance.
ja: これが、最初で最後の機会だ。

key: SIRIUS: Go.
en: SIRIUS: Go.
ja: シリウス: 行け。

key: I will not afford you the chance to be told twice.
en: I will not afford you the chance to be told twice.
ja: 二度は言わせないぞ。

key: zeL: Good luck, \PN...
en: zeL: Good luck, \PN...
ja: ゼル: 頑張ってね、\PN……

key: Zel: Lumi, \PN is the enemy, don't wish them luck!
en: Zel: Lumi, \PN is the enemy, don't wish them luck!
ja: ゼル: ルミ、\PNは敵だぞ、幸運を祈るなよ!

key: zeL: O-oh... Right.
en: zeL: O-oh... Right.
ja: ゼル: あ、そっか……そうだった。
